Fashion Show

5th Annual All Black Attire Party

Wed, Sep 21, 2022 · 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM · MartinPatrick3

When
Wed, Sep 21, 2022 · 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM
Where
MartinPatrick3
212 3rd Ave N Ste 106, Minneapolis, MN
More: All Black Attire Party

Join MARTINPATRICK3 X IAMMOODY for the most anticipated Fall fashion event in Minneapolis.

The 5th Annual All-Black Attire Party in the alley returns!

1) Watch Minnesota’s top male models of all ages, ethnicities, and orientations walk the runway showcasing the best fall fashions available at MartinPatrick3.
2) Come dressed in your favorite black attire to party before, during, and after.
3) Mix, mingle and shop.
4) Enjoy complimentary cocktails from Jetset
5) Nosh on fun Hors d’oeuvre
6) Listen to funky beats by DJ Cousin Christopher
7) Special guest performance by 2X World Fancy Dance Champion Larry Yazzie
😎 Tickets required
